tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded session demonstrates logging in, navigating to the Magento admin 'Credit Memos' grid, applying multiple filters (credit memo #, order #, bill-to, refunded range), executing Search, exporting results in CSV, performing a mass-action (PDF Credit Memos) and opening a credit memo 'View' page. The recording contains stable element hashes for key controls and explicit href patterns for row View links.

Task Definition:
- Create a reusable, deterministic tool that: navigates to the credit memo grid, applies provided filters, clicks Search, optionally exports the grid in a chosen format, optionally performs a mass-action on selected rows (or a single row), and optionally opens a specific credit memo 'View' page. The tool must use recorded stable selectors where available and prefer scoping selectors to the sales_creditmemo grid.

Action Plan:
1) Navigate to {admin_base_url}/sales_creditmemo/.
2) Close overlay if present (recorded close elementHash).
3) Populate filter fields (increment_id, order_increment_id, billing_name, refunded_from, refunded_to) using the elementHashes recorded during the demo.
4) Click the grid 'Search' control and wait for results.
5) If requested, select export format and trigger Export.
6) If requested, select rows (single-row checkbox or 'Select Visible' then mass-action), select the mass-action option and submit.
7) Extract visible grid rows into structured output for verification.
8) If requested, open the View link for a specified credit memo increment.

Variable Identification:
- admin_base_url: root admin URL to navigate from. (required)
- increment_id: grid filter field mapped to input name 'increment_id' (optional).
- order_increment_id: grid filter field mapped to 'order_increment_id' (optional).
- billing_name: grid filter field 'billing_name' (optional).
- refunded_from/refunded_to: grid range inputs for refunded amount (optional).
- export_format: visible text of export option (CSV/Excel/XML) (optional).
- massaction_option_text: exact visible text of the mass-action option to perform (e.g. 'PDF Credit Memos') (optional).
- select_visible_rows: boolean to indicate whether to click 'Select Visible' before mass-action (optional).
- open_view_increment: target credit memo increment to open (optional).
- wait_seconds_after_navigation: tune waiting for slow environments (optional).

Step Optimization:
- Use direct navigation to the grid URL instead of navigating through menus.
- Use the recorded elementHash values for deterministic clicks and inputs to avoid ambiguous selectors; fallback XPaths are documented in the analysis notes but elementHash is used in the steps for stability.
- Combine repeated waits with short, explicit wait steps after operations that change the grid (Search, Export, mass-action) to give the server time to respond; use small waits to remain deterministic.
- Extraction step returns structured results so callers can confirm filtering worked before mass-action or view navigation.

Notes and Limitations:
- The tool assumes an authenticated admin session is present in the browser context when it runs (the demo used admin/password123 to login). Authentication steps are intentionally omitted per instructions.
- If the environment uses different DOM (grid id or input names differ), the caller should validate the selectors or adjust elementHash/scoped XPaths. The tool includes stable element hashes recorded during a successful demo; when these fail, fallback to header-scoped XPaths recommended in the analysis.
- The tool performs deterministic actions only; it does not implement conditional branching (e.g., it always attempts export and mass-action steps; callers should provide only the parameters needed for desired behavior).
name: magento_admin_creditmemo_finder
description: Automate locating credit memos in Magento Admin (sales_creditmemo grid): apply filters (credit memo #, order #, bill-to, refunded range), run Search, export results (CSV/Excel/XML), perform a mass-action (e.g. PDF Credit Memos) and open a credit memo View. Uses stable element hashes recorded during a demonstration and XPath fallbacks. Assumes an authenticated admin session is present when the tool runs.

steps.description: Navigate to the Credit Memos admin grid page.
Brief wait to allow the page and grid to render (adjustable by wait_seconds_after_navigation parameter).
Close the 'Incoming Message' overlay if present (recorded elementHash from the demo).
Enter Credit Memo # into the grid filter input (maps to increment_id). Leave blank if {increment_id} not supplied.
Enter Order # into the grid filter input (maps to order_increment_id). Leave blank if {order_increment_id} not supplied.
Enter Bill to Name into the grid filter input (maps to billing_name). Leave blank if {billing_name} not supplied.
Enter Refunded 'From' amount into the grid filter range input. Leave blank if {refunded_from} not supplied.
Enter Refunded 'To' amount into the grid filter range input. Leave blank if {refunded_to} not supplied.
Click the 'Search' button in the grid filter area to apply filters and refresh results.
Wait for the filtered grid to re-render after Search. Increase if needed in slow environments.
If {export_format} is provided, select the desired export format from the 'Export to' dropdown (recorded elementHash used).
Click the 'Export' button to download/export the grid in the selected format.
Short wait to allow the export request to initiate.

If performing a mass-action on a single visible row, click the row checkbox for the first visible result (example checkbox elementHash). For selecting all visible rows use the 'Select Visible' link via massaction flow below instead.
Select the requested option from the mass-action 'Actions' dropdown (use exact visible option text like 'PDF Credit Memos' or the option value).
Click the mass-action 'Submit' button to perform the selected mass-action on selected rows.
Wait for mass-action to process (server-side task may take longer depending on action).
Extract the visible result rows after filters/search to return structured data for downstream use.
steps.goal: Capture the first page of grid result rows (credit memo increment, order number, bill-to name, refunded amount) into 'search_results'

steps.description: If {open_view_increment} is provided and matches a visible row, click the 'View' link for that credit memo (recorded elementHash for opening a memo in demo).

input_schema.name: admin_base_url
input_schema.description: Full Magento admin base URL (example: 'http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin'). Tool will navigate to {admin_base_url}/sales_creditmemo/.

input_schema.name: increment_id
input_schema.description: Credit Memo increment id (displayed 'Credit Memo #' e.g. '100000006'). This maps to the grid filter input name 'increment_id' and can be used to locate a specific row.

input_schema.name: order_increment_id
input_schema.description: Order increment id (Order #) to filter (maps to 'order_increment_id' filter input).

input_schema.name: billing_name
input_schema.description: Bill to Name filter (maps to 'billing_name' filter input). Use exact or partial customer name (e.g. 'Jane Smith').

input_schema.name: refunded_from
input_schema.description: Refunded amount 'From' (numeric or currency string without symbol). Maps to grid range input (e.g. '100').

input_schema.name: refunded_to
input_schema.description: Refunded amount 'To' (numeric or currency string without symbol).

input_schema.name: export_format
input_schema.description: If provided, the tool will select this format from the 'Export to' control and trigger Export.

input_schema.name: massaction_option_text
input_schema.description: Visible text of the mass-action option to perform (for example: 'PDF Credit Memos'). If provided the tool will select this option from the Actions dropdown and click Submit.

input_schema.name: select_visible_rows
input_schema.description: If true, the tool will click the 'Select Visible' link before performing mass action to select all visible rows. Defaults to false when omitted.

input_schema.name: open_view_increment
input_schema.description: If provided, the tool will open the credit memo 'View' link for this increment id (e.g. '100000006'). If omitted no 'View' navigation is performed.

input_schema.name: wait_seconds_after_navigation
input_schema.description: Seconds to wait after navigation to the grid to allow rendering (useful for slow environments). Default behavior uses a short wait if omitted.
